programme.title: 第12集 - 諾曼生病了
programme.desc: 諾曼是曾經跟史帝夫在顎劇場表演的鱷魚, 現在牠已經失去全口的牙齒, 幾乎無法進食, 而且上顎長出莫名其妙的東西, 可能是某種腫瘤或長期感染, 必須全身麻醉照X光才能確定問題所在。澳洲動物園年初時來了三隻漂亮的蘇門答臘幼虎, 麥康、莎麗和莎琪, 園方訓練牠們增強自信、激發親水的天性, 準備跟青少虎尼爾森見面。澳洲在2020年初時爆發史上最可怕致命的野火, 造成超過卅億隻動物喪命, 無尾熊管理員布魯克和艾登南下袋鼠島, 接回三母二公幼小的無尾熊。

programme.title: 第6集 - 巴西巨森蚺
programme.desc: 本集節目中, 野生生物學家佛瑞斯特葛蘭特要去巴西波尼托尋找巨蛇。根據傳說, 神秘的治療師將巨蛇困在地下, 拯救了這個小鎮。葛蘭特要去搜索波尼托附近的地下洞窟跟叢林裡的水域, 試著找到故事中的巨蛇, 他能順利達成任務嗎?

programme.title: 第6集 - 鬥牛犬動手術
programme.desc: 在今天的熱血獸醫院中, 傑夫要救治一隻吞了芒果核的狗高斯。高斯主人帶牠到醫院之前, 高斯已經連續嘔吐了二十五次。傑夫醫生為高斯觸診後, 發現牠的腹部有異物。在照X光確認有異物後, 傑夫便決定開刀取出。但他在開刀後發現, 異物已經到達結腸。結腸內的細菌很多, 如果開刀可能會造成腸胃道感染。因此傑夫決定將異物推擠出來。最後傑夫為高斯灌腸, 並在太太佩特拉的協助下, 取出高斯體內的芒果核。高斯在手術後一直不吃東西, 讓傑夫很擔心手術是否出了問題。但高斯一看到主人後, 就高興地吃起東西了。

programme.title: 第2集 - 花豹: 沙漠與熱浪
programme.desc: 花豹為了保護獵到的食物不被偷走, 把獵物扛上樹, 樹上的空氣也比較涼爽。

programme.title: 第5集 - 神奇的髭頰蜥
programme.desc: 赫斯勒家請康乃爾世界替養了五個月的寵物髭頰蜥-奈許, 依據電影大娛樂家的概念, 打造一個馬戲團缸。同時還替奈許添了一個髭頰蜥同伴-威斯特。葛雷格想替即將小學畢業的女兒愛瑪舉辦驚喜派對, 還請了店裡的爬蟲專家小傑, 帶牠珍藏的爬蟲來介紹給愛瑪與愛瑪的朋友。

programme.title: 第11集 - Sleeping Murder
programme.desc: 音無剛一認同了莉音得出的答案。不過琴子卻加以否定, 篤定地斷言澄並非是因自殺而死, 真兇另有其人!其實她掌握著從妖狐那裡打聽來且尚未公開的「某個重大真相」。真正的凶手究竟是誰?

programme.title: 第24集 - Blackout
programme.desc: 魔法騎士團的成員受到強大的空間魔法影響而憑空消失。當下及時反應過來的尤諾順利逃脫後, 與魔力強大的凱薩琳陷入交戰局面。敵人射出的咒彈讓他的身體漸漸失去知覺, 不甘心的尤諾此時發現自己的魔產生的變化。面對逃過一劫的亞斯塔等人, 拉迪斯卻顯得從容。

programme.title: 第25集 - Adversity
programme.desc: 費根雷翁團長在亞斯塔等人的面前被空間魔法捕獲並消失。諾艾兒從發動的魔法性質推測出施術者就在附近。亞斯塔揭開主使者的真面目後, 眾人目睹了不敢置信的景象。此時尤諾在風之精靈希爾芙的幫助下重創凱薩琳, 她轉而攻擊剛好在場的黑色暴牛團成員恰咪。

programme.title: 第3集 - Fan/Bewilder Ball/Cat Rescue/Rain
programme.desc: 分明都10月了卻一早就天氣酷熱, 這一天高木同學和西片比平時還早到校。兩人用西片帶的扇子, 比賽誰能讓橡皮擦移動得更遠...這場比賽, 誰會是贏家...?收錄「魔球」、「拯救貓咪」、「雨」等四個章節。

programme.title: 第4集 - Uniform Change/Winter Uniform/Lunch/Ufo/Night
programme.desc: 高木同學在寒冷天氣穿著夏季制服上學, 只要讓高木同學說「好冷」就算她輸了...西片是否能讓高木同學說出「好冷」呢... 收錄「冬季制服」、「便當」、「幽浮」、「晚上」等五個章節。

programme.title: 第55集 - Howl
programme.desc: 亞連無法阻止陷入降咎狀態的斯曼失控, 村子因此遭破壞焚毀, 四處逃竄的百姓悲痛欲絕。斯曼聽到一個男孩因父母死去的心碎哭聲後恢復自我。然而, 他的失控並未停止, 還破壞得更慘烈。此時亞連由於釋放了全力, 左手無法動彈, 無能為力的他陷入絕望中。

programme.title: 第56集 - Delete
programme.desc: 看到斯曼突然死去後亞連感到震驚, 此時有名神秘男人帝奇出現在他面前。亞連認出眼前的男人是諾亞一族的成員, 於是發動猛攻。對方躲開後用手臂貫穿亞連的胸口, 但神奇的是傷口既無痛感也未流血。接著能夠穿透物體並碰到目標物的帝奇將手伸向亞連的心臟。

programme.title: 第10集 - Uninvited Judge
programme.desc: 音無莉音與亮馬回顧遭殺害的澄度過的一生。澄總是遵從父親音無傳次郎決定的方針, 獻上自己的人生促進集團發展。不料那套成功法則卻不持久, 本來被逼到崩毀邊緣的集團因為澄的命案得以脫離危機。莉音分析事情原委後, 宣稱自己可能得知了事件真相。

programme.title: 香港盜賊之王

programme.title: 第6集 - 雙胞胎嬰兒綁架案
programme.desc: 薩凡納一名年輕母親被發現中槍倒臥鄰居家門前，探員其後揭開令人心寒的轉折：她的新生雙胞胎竟被一名在媽媽群組認識的女子綁架。

programme.title: Evil Up Close:6 E1 -Women Who Kill - Thelma Yvonne Purchase
programme.desc: Greg Baker was a mathematician and calligrapher, and a devout Christian. He was disabled and reliant on caregivers. One of those was Thelma Yvonne Purchase, who took his life to get her hands on his money.

programme.title: 第1集 - 女性兇手 - 席瑪·伊馮娜·蒲切斯
programme.desc: 格雷格·貝克是數學家和書法家，也是虔誠的基督徒。他是身障人士，需依賴看護。其中一個看護是席瑪·伊馮娜·蒲切斯，她奪走他的生命和金錢。

programme.title: Taking The Stand:2 E2 -Nancy Brophy
programme.desc: Romance novelist Nancy Brophy faces life in prison for the murder of her husband, Chef Dan Brophy. After finding surveillance video showing Nancy's minivan driving around the time and area of his murder.

programme.title: 第2集 - 南西·布洛菲
programme.desc: 言情小說家南西·布洛菲因廚師丈夫丹·布洛菲的命案而面臨無期徒刑。主要依據是找到了監視器影片，其中顯示南西的小廂型車駕駛情況差不多吻合命案的時間和區域。

programme.title: Cold Case Files: DNA Speaks E6 -A Deadly Premonition
programme.desc: When Linda Slaten is brutally strangled in her Lakeland, FL, home, a web of suspects emerges. The case takes a dramatic turn when a DNA hit exposes the sinister underbelly of this peaceful community.

programme.title: 第6集 - 致命預感
programme.desc: 蓮達斯萊頓 (Linda Slaten) 在佛羅里達州雷克蘭 (Lakeland) 的家中慘遭勒斃，多名嫌疑人逐一浮現。當警方透過DNA比對取得突破，案件揭露了這個寧靜社區背後潛藏的黑暗真相。

programme.title: Accused: Guilty Or Innocent?:6 E6 -Cold Blooded Killer Or Bereaved Teen?
programme.desc: Two Houston parents are shot dead as they sleep, and their teenage son stands accused of murder. The legal battle deepens as new evidence is discovered.

programme.title: 第6集 - 冷血殺手還是喪親少年？
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​兩名休士頓的父母在熟睡中遭到槍擊身亡，而他們的青少年兒子則被指控犯下謀殺罪。隨著新的證據被發現，圍繞此案的法律攻防戰持續加深，案件的走向也變得更加複雜。

programme.title: City Confidential:9 E5 -Midnight Pain In Georgia
programme.desc: Holiday spirit all but disappears from Marietta, Georgia, when one of its most festive residents is found murdered in his own home.

programme.title: 第5集 - 喬治亞午夜血案
programme.desc: 喬治亞州馬列塔的節日氣氛在一夜之間消失殆盡，當地最熱愛節慶的居民之一被發現陳屍家中，令全鎮陷入悲痛與疑懼。

programme.title: Interrogation Raw:2 E20 -Gone Girl
programme.desc: A Florida mother vanishes into the night after celebrating her daughter's first birthday. In their search to find her, the police seek answers from the father of her child.

programme.title: 第20集 - 逝去的女孩
programme.desc: 佛羅里達州的一名母親在慶祝女兒的一歲生日後，消失在夜幕中。警方搜索時，也希望孩子的父親能給出答案。

programme.title: Beyond The Headlines: Black Girl Missing
programme.desc: Companion piece to the movie Black Girl Missing. While the media goes into a frenzy over missing white girls, Black women's disappearances receive muted coverage and limited police resources.

programme.title: 頭條新聞之外：黑人女孩失蹤事件
programme.desc: 本集是電影《黑人女孩失蹤事件》(Black Girl Missing)的觀影指南。媒體總是積極報導失蹤的白人女孩，但黑人女性失蹤案件的報導率不高，獲得的警方資源也有限。

programme.title: Murder In The 21st E2 -The Girl Next Door
programme.desc: The community of Macon, GA, is gripped in a wave of terror when a beautiful law student disappears from her apartment complex. Nobody knows where she could be or what could have happened.

programme.title: 第2集 - 隔壁的女孩
programme.desc: 喬治亞州梅肯的社區籠罩在恐懼當中，因為一個漂亮的法律系學生從她的公寓失蹤了。沒有人知道她可能在哪裡，或可能發生了什麼事。

programme.title: Murder At The Motel E2 -The Bad Guy Did It

programme.title: 第2集 - 壞人做的
programme.desc: 2020年5月13日，內華達州雷諾。數名汽車旅館客人回報在午夜聽見槍聲，於是來自雷諾警察局的警察前往La Quinta旅館。

programme.title: Women On Death Row E1 -Shawna Forde
programme.desc: Shawna Forde was convicted for a 2009 crime that resulted in the violent murders of Raul Flores and his 9-year-old daughter Brisenia. She was sentenced to death.

programme.title: 第1集 - 尚娜·福德
programme.desc: 尚娜·福德在2009年因勞爾·弗洛爾及其9歲女兒布莉森妮雅的暴力命案而遭定罪。她被判死刑。

programme.title: Women On Death Row E2 -Sandi Nieves
programme.desc: In 1998, a fire in Sandi Nieves' home that started under suspicious circumstances led to her conviction for arson, the murders of her four daughters, and the attempted murder of her son David.

programme.title: 第2集 - 姍蒂·尼維斯
programme.desc: 在1998年，姍蒂·尼維斯家中在可疑情況下發生的火災，導致她被判縱火罪、謀殺四個女兒，以及謀殺兒子大衛未遂。

programme.title: Alaska State Troopers:9 E7 -Cold Truth And Consequences
programme.desc: In the Mat-Su, Troopers catch a runner connected to an alleged Facebook scam and arrest a suspect wanted on murder charges. In Fairbanks, two hunters are caught butchering a moose in a bank drive-thru.

programme.desc: 在馬蘇地區，州警拘捕一名與懷疑 Facebook 騙案有關的逃犯，並拘捕一名涉嫌謀殺而被通緝的疑犯。在費爾班克斯，兩名獵人在銀行免下車通道內宰割駝鹿時被當場揭發。

programme.title: Booked: First Day In:2 E6 -Public Drunk At A Bar!
programme.desc: In Virginia Beach, one man is struggling to feed his kids while another is surprised to find he owes child support. A woman is indignant to learn she's been arrested for getting drunk in a bar.

programme.title: 第6集 - 在酒吧喝個爛醉！
programme.desc: 在維吉尼亞州海灘，一名男子努力餵養孩子，而另一名男子則驚訝地發現他沒有付子女撫養費。一名女子憤怒地得知自己因在酒吧喝醉而遭到逮捕。

programme.title: Women On Death Row E1 -Shawna Forde
programme.desc: Shawna Forde was convicted for a 2009 crime that resulted in the violent murders of Raul Flores and his 9-year-old daughter Brisenia. She was sentenced to death.

programme.title: 第1集 - 尚娜·福德
programme.desc: 尚娜·福德在2009年因勞爾·弗洛爾及其9歲女兒布莉森妮雅的暴力命案而遭定罪。她被判死刑。

programme.title: 第4集 - 日本的紅
programme.desc: 紅在西方代表的是憤怒和暴力, 但在日本卻意味著平靜。在日本, 紅是歷史的一部分, 也是一股安撫人們的力量。

programme.title: 第2集 - 沈觀遠
programme.desc: 沈觀遠以叛逆創意挑戰料理框架, 從失敗中淬鍊風格, 在極小空間端出前所未見的飲食體驗。

programme.title: 第6集 - 黃慧嫻
programme.desc: 《主廚本色》深入亞洲烹飪世界, 聚焦六位最大膽、備受推崇的頂尖主廚, 揭開他們不為人知的真實故事。

programme.title: 第1集 - 我記憶中的李光耀
programme.desc: 新加坡第一任總理李光耀先生廣受人民愛戴, 帶領新加坡走上康莊大道。本集有許多和他接觸過的人現身說法, 細數他令人感念及為國為民付出的種種行為與回憶。

programme.title: 第2集 - 他說過的話
programme.desc: 由於新加坡和馬來西亞的執政黨在政治及經濟方面產生重大歧異, 李光耀帶領新加坡脫離聯邦, 在往後的數十年以鋼鐵般的意志, 將新加坡打造成亞洲的強大城邦。

programme.title: 第2集 - 馴鹿部落
programme.desc: 在蒙古的泰加林區, 圖瓦馴鹿牧民必須在馴鹿與孩子的教育之間做出抉擇。

programme.title: 第3集 - 獵鷹圖騰
programme.desc: 在蒙古最西部的巴彥烏列蓋省, 哈薩克遊牧民族捕捉並訓練金雕, 用來獵捕狐貍與狼。

programme.title: 第11集 - 林中騷動
programme.desc: 《島嶼猩樂園》成立至今即將屆滿一週年, 所有紅毛猩猩的森林生活技能全都大有長進, 但是有一個例外: 許多猩猩都不肯住在樹頂, 雖然這能讓牠們躲避掠食者, 尤其是在晚上。為了證實她的猜測, 蘿恩暗自夜探島嶼, 勘察紅毛猩猩在哪些地方睡覺。她的發現讓她展開一項冒險計畫, 但計畫是否會成功?同時, 哈姆雷特偷偷回到帕拉斯島, 大夥頓時群龍無首。千千是否會繼任成為帶頭老大?或是島上將掀起一陣大亂?

programme.title: 第12集 - 誰與爭鋒
programme.desc: 蘿恩的冒險計畫是為了鼓勵這群失怙的紅毛猩猩, 多花點時間待在樹頂。雖然這項計劃有個致命缺點, 但她並不為此氣餒, 仍積極尋求新的解決方案。同時, 島嶼的氣氛日漸緊張, 大家尋龍無首, 直到哈姆雷特突然又回來了。不過, 牠的再度出現無法立刻解決問題, 因為另一場對決又將展開。哈姆雷特這次不是單獨回來, 另一隻帕拉斯島的年長公猩猩跟著牠一起現身, 這可能會威脅《島嶼猩樂園》的年輕族群。此外, 莫哥與牠的死黨發現另一種蛋白質來源─黃蜂!

programme.title: 第1集 - 奮力求生
programme.desc: Following Lone Droscher-Nielsen and her team, as they race against time to protect and save the orangutans. Narrated by Virginia Madsen.

第4集 - 多變的冰河
programme.desc: 在本集的求生1加1當中,寇迪和喬在挪威高地的冰天雪地中求生,半途遇到了刺骨的寒風,加上天黑後溫度會驟降,如果沒有適當的遮蔽處,幾乎保證會失溫而死,但寇迪只穿著短褲和毛襪,他的這個裝扮惹火了喬,兩人不僅得趕在日落前找到可以保命的遮蔽處,還一路為了此事爭執不休,終於,在長途跋涉,全身凍僵之後,寇迪勉強找到一個可以棲身的遮蔽處,讓他們得以平安度過一夜,隔天,又得開始艱辛的旅程,他們又冷又餓,只能把目標放在找個理想的地點,搭起薩米帳篷,生個營火,好好飽餐一頓,然後安心地睡個覺,把體力補足以後,再繼續上路尋找救援的機會,然而,就在他們找到一條溪流,沿著溪流往下游走,以為就要找到救援時,卻發現前方是一處斷崖...

programme.title: 鯊魚世家
programme.desc: 在紐西蘭的海域中, 數個大白鯊世家爭奪霸權。

programme.title: 第11集 - 積雪攪局
programme.desc: 清運一處佔地近3公頃、積雪覆蓋的囤積地, 將麥特逼到崩潰邊緣。為了淨空階梯, 團隊清掉了近230公斤的垃圾, 以便到頂樓尋找遺失的金塊。

programme.title: 第1集 - 半鱷半魚怪
programme.desc: 本集節目中, 傑洛米韋德來到美國南部的德州, 實地尋找傳言中屢屢攻擊人類的河中巨怪:鱷雀鱔。據說這種生物兇猛如鯊、體型如鱷, 而且擁有尖銳無比的牙齒與堅硬無比的魚鱗。乍聽之下, 鱷雀鱔確實擁有襲擊人類的能力。民間更盛傳河中巨怪攻擊人的故事, 報紙也繪聲繪影地報導鱷雀鱔比食人鯊更危險, 導致大街小巷人心惶惶。但隨著主持人傑洛米韋德實地走訪棲息地, 徵詢專家意見, 請他們分享經驗與傳授秘訣, 甚至還親自上船垂釣, 就為了一睹鱷雀鱔的廬山真面目。幾經抽絲剝繭, 進一步瞭解此生物的習性及背景後, 他發現鱷雀鱔可能僅是代罪羔羊, 並希望鱷雀鱔如果不是原兇, 就該還牠一個清白。且看傑洛米韋德如何解開這些流傳多年, 駭人聽聞的謎團。

programme.title: 第2集 - 奔赴林海
programme.desc: 王一博在史誇米希的花崗巖峭壁挑戰器械攀登, 並體驗當地伐木文化, 包括飛斧與水上滾木。

programme.title: 第3集 - 失蹤的漁夫
programme.desc: 在甘榜檳城村莊, 有一名漁夫在河中佈網捕魚, 卻一去不回。已知他去捕魚的水道裡, 潛伏著鱷魚, 因此消防救援局派捕鱷專家去誘捕大鱷魚。捕鱷專家把雞肉綁在浮標上, 順利捕捉到鱷魚, 但是費了好大的工夫, 才把這隻巨猛鱷殺死並拖上岸。在婆羅洲馬來熊保育中心, 研究員黃修德獲報去救回一隻豢養幼熊。帶回中心做健檢時, 他發現這隻幼熊的四顆犬齒已經被拔掉了, 無法野放。然而飼育員在一次被馬來熊嚼手的情況中, 覺得刮劃的力道變得很強, 於是打開牠的嘴巴檢查, 驚喜地發現犬齒開始長回來了, 原來當初被拔掉的犬齒只是乳齒而已。如今這隻馬來熊又有了野放的希望。

programme.title: 第1集 - 對決巨木
programme.desc: 白手起家的傑瑞德建立伐木公司, 率眾深入大平洋西北地區的深山, 在這裡過著沒水沒電, 與世隔離的生活, 只為了砍伐美國側柏這種珍貴的木材。

programme.title: 第18集 - 分毫之差

programme.title: 第12集 - 罕見手槍
programme.desc: 麥特接手一座堆滿雜物的鬼鎮, 同時尋找一把稀有柯特左輪手槍。一張貝比魯斯簽名被證實是真跡。一件復古利惠牌單品賣出高價。

programme.title: 第1集 - 外星蹤跡
programme.desc: 百慕達三角發生過多起人口、船隻或飛機失蹤事件, 因此又有「魔鬼三角」之稱。這些失蹤事件過於離奇, 引發各種臆測, 幽浮及外星人綁架論也隨之而生。在本節目中, 由四名百慕達三角資深調查員組成的魔鬼三角調查團將冒險涉入這片危險海域, 以尋找不可思議的真相。調查團首先舉辦了幽浮市鎮大會, 要聽聽當地航海界人士的相關目擊經驗分享, 而其中目擊者文尼的故事特別令人印象深刻。文尼２０１３年４月某日在海邊目擊到一個球狀飛行物, 其飛行速度極快, 還能任意進出海面, 十分不尋常。調查團從他的故事開始展開調查, 他們使用最先進設備, 親自下海搜索相關地點, 就為了找出可以證明幽浮存在的鐵證。

programme.title: Dark Matters: Twisted But True S2E13 -Magical Jet Propulsion Missing Link Mystery Typhoid Mary
programme.desc: One man combined the occult and rockets to produce the technology that underpinned Mutually Assured Destruction.

programme.title: 第13集 - 遺環之謎
programme.desc: 致命疾病的帶原者是受害者還是殺人兇手?將魔法與火箭結合的科學家, 以及失落的演化環節。

programme.title: How Do They Do It? S13E12 -Emergency Bridges, Marker Pens, And Electric Superbikes
programme.desc: How do they build emergency bridges that can take the weight of a tank? How do they make a marker pen that never fades?

programme.title: 第12集 - 緊急橋樑,神奇筆,電動摩托車
programme.desc: 本集首先介紹能在戰區迅速搭建的乾式支援橋。這種組合式的橋梁必須輕量又堅固, 易於運輸, 又能支撐坦克等重型車輛。接著是油性麥克筆及螢光筆, 除了看筆的各部位如何組成完整的筆, 也看神奇發光墨水的製作過程。最後是電動超級摩托車, 透過簡化及輕量化, 製造出世界上速度最快的機車。

programme.title: How It's Made S8E13 -Leather Wallets, French Horns, Soy Sauce, Children's Ride-On Cars
programme.desc: Find out how Leather wallets; French horns; soy sauce; and children's ride-on cars are made.

programme.title: 第13集 - 皮夾,法國號,醬油,兒童汽車
programme.desc: 本集節目介紹皮夾、法國號、醬油和兒童汽車的製作。手工皮夾的作法是將皮與布拼排、黏製成內袋, 再將內袋與外層皮料縫合, 最後修剪而完成。法國號是將黃銅板型塑成各式管件, 包括吹管、調音管、鐘形口等, 將管件一一焊接, 再加上活瓣、轉閥等零件而成。醬油是將煮熟的大豆和烤過的小麥, 與滷水和酵母混合, 靜置發酵12個月形成醬醪, 擠壓醬醪所流出的液體即為醬油。兒童汽車是將塑料熔融模製成各個零件, 再將成品修整、燒灼、貼上商標, 最後將零件打包便完成。

programme.title: You Have Been Warned S6E6 -Ultimate Upgraders
programme.desc: Focuses on creative garage innovators taking inventions to the next level, from using fire to charge phones to creating the world's fastest electric dragster.

programme.title: 第6集 - 誇張升級
programme.desc: 本集的「網路影片大解碼」再度在網路上尋找最熱門、最酷炫的網路影片, 並由科學家團隊對這些改造物品進行說明講解, 前往世界各地拜訪作者的創作理念, 最後針對內容最有趣、最具意義的作品進行排名, 找出世上最精彩的巧思創作。

programme.desc: Strange sightings of mysterious lights and orbs are common in the Bermuda Triangle, and to find the truth behind these unexplained phenomena.

programme.title: 第2集 - 無法解釋的接觸
programme.desc: 百慕達三角可說是世上最謎樣的地方, 不僅發生過許多特殊事件, 更有許多人、船隻或飛機在此失蹤。發生這些離奇事件的原因眾說紛紜, 有人就認為百慕達三角絕對存在著超自然現象。魔鬼三角調查團這回的調查主題是不明潛水物, 又簡稱ＵＳＯ。他們找到聲稱見過不明潛水物的目擊者東尼羅伯茲, 身為船長的東尼有次開著遊船出海時, 發現海中有個圓形發光物在船的周圍繞來繞去, 並突然消失。調查團根據東尼所提供的照片和目擊位置展開了調查, 他們出航後竟然在一片汪洋中的海床上發現了一個奇怪井狀構造, 該構造相當龐大, 邊角筆直, 既不像自然生成, 也不像人類所為。這項發現會與東尼的目擊事件有關聯嗎?

programme.desc: Brilliant Minds will tell the stories of the strange lives of the visionaries of science fiction, reveal the secrets of their uncanny ability to see the future.

programme.desc: Brilliant Minds will tell the stories of the strange lives of the visionaries of science fiction, reveal the secrets of their uncanny ability to see the future.

programme.title: How Do They Do It? S13E13 -Crystal Glass, Flat Screen Tvs, World's Deepest Swimming Pool, And Ketchup
programme.desc: How do they blow the world's finest crystal wine glasses? How do they make the world's slimmest TVs?

programme.title: 第13集 - 酒杯,超薄電視,游泳池,蕃茄醬
programme.desc: 專家指出, 不同酒杯能帶來不同味道, 因此酒杯的製作也是相當重要。大型LED電視是由精密的電子組件所生產, 維士托工業園區將帶你進入電視生產的世界。米勒皮尼泰梅酒店的Y-40「深悅」是世界上最深的游泳池, 尤其適合自由潛水專家為比賽進行練習。番茄醬的名稱多到數不清, 但有一點是一樣的－人人都愛吃。這些驚人的發明究竟是怎麼辦到的?

programme.title: How It's Made S8E14 -Glass Paperweights, Road Salt, Nutcrackers, Car Doors
programme.desc: Find out how Millefiori Glass Paperweightt, Road Salt, Nutcrackers, and Car Doors are made.

programme.title: 第14集 - 玻璃紙鎮,道路用鹽,胡桃鉗,車門
programme.desc: 本集介紹四種產品的製造過程: 玻璃紙鎮, 道路用鹽, 胡桃鉗與車門。玻璃製作技術發展於15世紀的義大利, 將排成圖案的彩色玻璃棒切割下來, 組成花朵的造型, 安排成錯綜複雜的圖形包覆在透明水晶裡。兩位加拿大藝術家則利用此種工藝打造美麗的玻璃紙鎮。當前方道路上有層薄冰, 巖鹽能夠讓這問題消逝無蹤, 鹽能降低水的融點進而融冰, 同時還能避免再度結冰。鹽首先於1930年代用於公路或人行道上除冰, 但一直到1960年代才廣泛使用。第一支胡桃鉗是純粹用途取向的工具, 但到了15世紀, 歐洲木雕匠開始製作漂亮的胡桃鉗, 外型彷若動物或人形。本集要介紹胡桃鉗人偶的製作。車門在過去一世紀中有不少演進, 它們變得輕量以改善燃油效率, 又夠強固足以抵抗撞擊力道, 它們也內含許多電子機構, 例如揚聲器與電動窗, 這些都能讓日常通勤更便利。

programme.title: You Have Been Warned S6E7 -Mvps
programme.desc: A look at the internet's Most Valuable Players in science. Featuring a brave sportsman skiing behind a supercar and people pulling cars with their teeth!

programme.title: 第7集 - 最有價值選手
programme.desc: 本集的主題是網路最有價值選手, 第20至11名有「靈魂出竅」飄移車手、熔爐烤披薩、會拔牙的長尾鸚鵡, 以及有特異肌肉的魔鬼筋肉人。前十名則包含牙齒拖車男、在車陣單腳溜直排輪的老頭、網路舞步的原創者麗色裙天堂鳥, 以及在太空球內住一晚的瘋狂男子。第一名得主是英國奧運滑雪選手葛拉罕貝爾, 他要去瑞典挑戰一個不可能的極速任務...

programme.title: Great American Eclipse S1E1 -Countdown To Darkness
programme.desc: In 2017, a solar eclipse crossed the United States for the first time in 99 years. Cutting-edge NASA missions investigate this once-in-a-life-time event.

programme.title: 第1集 - 日全蝕全記錄
programme.desc: 超級日全蝕在睽違99年後, 再次重返美國本土。民眾與天文學界摩拳擦掌、準備追蹤難得奇景。

programme.title: Invent It Rich S2E6 -Disappearing Acts
programme.desc: Brook & Brian help Marc vet four big claims: a disappearing ink that allows paper to be reused; a remote control steering system for a jet ski.

programme.title: 第6集 - Disappearing Acts
programme.desc: 這次有四組自創者尋求風險投資家馬克波特尼的投資, 他們分別是強調自然醒的鬧鐘、一個人也能玩花式滑水的遙控滑水器, 還有會自動消失的印表機墨水, 可以讓紙張重複列印, 最後是消除馬桶臭味的除臭機。這四個產品在自我介紹後, 要經過布魯克德和布萊恩羅伊的實地測試, 再交給一般大眾做評估, 最後交給馬克做最後的決定。這次的四個產品表現都非常優秀, 在專家提出建議之後, 馬克先放棄藍色地球墨水和醒醒鬧鐘, 最後只剩下遙控滑水器和諾莫馬桶除臭器爭取馬克的資金。

programme.title: The Big Experiment S1E1
programme.desc: The scientists get their first look at the school and the teenagers they're going to be working with and it's not encouraging!

programme.title: 第1集
programme.desc: 英國最熱忱的三名科學家, 離開實驗室六週, 到倫敦數一數二難搞的班級, 要讓學生體會到科學能改變自己的生活。化學家彼德在第一天的教學中, 使用教具讓學生認識原子的組成, 但是控制教室秩序卻成了他的惡夢。之後他們開始用各種活動和實驗吸引學生的注意力, 最後甚至帶他們到倫敦的色情蘇活區, 看霓虹燈, 討論元素遇電發出不同顏色的現象。最後學生們要用一整週學到的知識, 進行勁爆實驗, 在五種掩蔽中, 選擇一種遇到雷擊能讓人毫髮無損的遮蔽, 是否有學生能選對呢?

programme.desc: 艾倫考夫曼幫其他人打造車子已經太久, 現在要走不同的方向, 在他的新車坊弧光裝配, 他正在設計副廠貨卡零件, 打造他一直以來都想做的獨特車輛。艾倫也從全美各地欽點了最棒的造車師傅加入團隊, 而打造這些特製車, 將挑戰他們在各個層面的技能和經驗, 而當車子完成, 他們都將一一拿來測試。這回他們繼續要把跑長途的工作卡車, 變成賽車, 還要在科羅拉多泉對上其他職業車手, 而且要用最快的速度做到。但是前方還有許多作業, 也非常可能把車撞壞, 但造車並不總是按照計畫進行, 而結局更是難以預料。

programme.desc: 諾亞開設經典車工坊, 讓車子好看, 對他們來說是一定要的, 讓車子性能好, 則是他們的專長。在經典車工坊這兒, 有遠見的工匠大師團隊, 經手各式各樣的車, 改造成為量身特製的高性能勁車, 你要贏得車展就另請高明, 若你要贏得車展又能衝第一, 來找他們就對了。今天車坊要把1986年的工作貨卡, 改裝成繞錐計時賽的猛將。還有一位空軍飛行員, 終於能把夢想車, 改成日常座駕。兩輛美國經典車, 準備迎向開放的道路。

programme.title: Alaska Mega Machines S1E4 -Bering Sea Giants
programme.desc: Alaska Mega Machines explores some of the biggest machines on Earth. Explore how they're engineered, what features they have to withstand the harsh Alaskan weather.

programme.title: 第4集 - 白令海巨無霸
programme.desc: 介紹格林溪銀礦、阿留申群島的荷蘭港、以及阿拉斯加第一間大型造船廠: 維閣造船廠。

programme.title: Heartland Thunder S1E6 -The Final Lap
programme.desc: The racers prepare for the most prestigious and financially lucrative race of the year, The Tom Karrick Memorial. Tim Karrick vows to win the race to honor his father.

programme.title: 第6集 - 最後決戰
programme.desc: 今晚本節目來到最後決戰, 一年中最知名的賽站湯姆卡瑞克紀念賽, 而這對堪薩斯市的車手圈可是非同小可, 實為劃下成功賽季句點, 或是替整季的失敗來贖罪的機會。這一季的比賽就快接近尾聲, 努力爭取此紀念賽的積分, 自是不在話下。這個以父親命名的賽事, 提姆當然很想拿下冠軍, 無奈本季他諸事不順, 加上上場比賽把車架整個撞彎, 除了得要拚命修車之外, 是否還能在這莫大的壓力之下跑出佳績?丹尼要進行大工程, 對調兩輛賽車的引擎, 忙碌之餘竟也和父親湯姆大吵一架, 思考著和老爸拆夥, 而另一方面湯姆則繼續積極尋找贊助商；賈斯丁邦尼有前車之鑑, 本週徹底檢查賽車所有部件, 同時間也得到了一具全新引擎, 且看這場上最大馬力能否轉換成第一名。

programme.title: Junkyard Empire S2E6 -Never Easy
programme.desc: Andy, Bobby and their team of quirky characters find the proverbial diamonds in the rough, chase down deals, and add value to what others throw away.

programme.title: 第6集 - 升級加值
programme.desc: 安迪的廢車場送來一輛報廢吉普車, 但外觀看起來還很好, 於是安迪決定要把車子整理一番再轉手賣掉。他找來得力助手湯米負責, 仔細後檢視才發現整輛車的後半部嚴重鏽蝕必須重新打造骨架。此外, 安迪在網路上看到有人賣把高爾夫球車改裝成經典車款的套裝車殼, 他認為可以靠此開拓商機, 還找了老爸幫他跟退休球友推銷。結果安迪想得太簡單, 原本以為可以在家中車庫完成改裝, 結果還是得靠湯米來幫他收尾。一位老客戶介紹來的客人賈斯汀, 他帶來一輛80年代經典車卡邁羅想要整修, 是他從小的鄰居太太過世後遺留給他的。雖然客人只有兩千元預算, 安迪仍大方地找人幫忙幫他將車子打造得煥然一新。

programme.title: Super Street Garage S1E8 -We Build Nads His Dream Civic With A Mix Of Era-Specific Mods
programme.desc: Nads always wanted a hot hatch, and his Civic Type R tribute checks all the right boxes with a curated blend of OEM-plus hardware and a complete color change.

programme.title: 第8集 - 夢幻喜美
programme.desc: 奈茲協助許多人打造本田改裝車, 卻從沒機會實現自己的夢想。在大家的協力合作下, 奈茲的1997年本田喜美改頭換面, 成為奈茲夢想中的改裝車。

programme.title: Car Fix S7E13 -Pantera
programme.desc: Jared and Lou find a Detomaso Pantera that has been sitting for almost 20 years and get the project headed in the right direction. They install an all new cooling setup.

programme.title: 第13集 - 回歸正統
programme.desc: 盧和傑瑞要整修一輛1973年的德托馬索黑豹超跑。

programme.title: Car Fix S7E14 -Tubular Fox Body
programme.desc: Install a Tubular front end with a new K-member setup. Jared and Lou makes some sparks and show you how to save 40 pounds of weight on the front end.

programme.title: 第14集 - 前身減重
programme.desc: 盧和傑瑞要在福克斯車身上改裝空心前端和空心K樑, 這樣可以讓車子重量減輕許多。

programme.title: Shifting Gears With Aaron Kaufman S1E5 -Semi-Charmed Kinda Truck
programme.desc: The clock is ticking as Aaron Kaufman and his Arclight builders struggle to finish their semi truck in time for race day at Pike's Peak International raceway.

programme.title: 第5集 - 毫不拖拉
programme.desc: 艾倫考夫曼幫其他人打造車子已經太久, 現在要走不同的方向, 在他的新車坊弧光裝配, 他正在設計副廠貨卡零件, 打造他一直以來都想做的獨特車輛。艾倫也從全美各地欽點了最棒的造車師傅加入團隊, 而打造這些特製車, 將挑戰他們在各個層面的技能和經驗, 而當車子完成, 他們都將一一拿來測試。這回他們繼續要把跑長途的工作卡車, 變成賽車, 還要在科羅拉多泉對上其他職業車手, 而且要用最快的速度做到。但是前方還有許多作業, 也非常可能把車撞壞, 但造車並不總是按照計畫進行, 而結局更是難以預料。

programme.title: Speed Is The New Black S2E5 -Hot Rod Power Tour
programme.desc: Noah and his crew decide to transform their clunker of a shop truck into a piece of rolling art, making it worthy of participating in the Hot Rod Power Tour.

programme.title: 第5集 - 改裝車動力之旅
programme.desc: 諾亞開設經典車工坊, 讓車子好看, 對他們來說是一定要的, 讓車子性能好, 則是他們的專長。在經典車工坊這兒, 有遠見的工匠大師團隊, 經手各式各樣的車, 改造成為量身特製的高性能勁車, 你要贏得車展就另請高明, 若你要贏得車展又能衝第一, 來找他們就對了。今天車坊要把1986年的工作貨卡, 改裝成繞錐計時賽的猛將。還有一位空軍飛行員, 終於能把夢想車, 改成日常座駕。兩輛美國經典車, 準備迎向開放的道路。

programme.title: Alaska Mega Machines S1E5 -Warriors In The Last Frontier
programme.desc: Alaska Mega Machines explores some of the biggest machines on Earth. Explore how they're engineered, what features they have to withstand the harsh Alaskan weather.

programme.title: 第5集 - 邊疆戰士
programme.desc: 恆星350B2直升機, 這架高速直升機協助阿拉斯加生命醫療救援隊快速地救援傷患, 搶救生命。

programme.title: American Loggers S1E1 -Timber In Their Blood
programme.desc: The week for Pelletier Inc. goes bad in a hurry. Rudy and his crews have to race to make up for lost time and just wind up falling further behind.

programme.title: 第1集 - 天生好漢
programme.desc: 裴勒提爾伐木公司是美國緬因州的家族企業, 由最初一人一車的運材工作, 發展至今已成為從採伐到運送的全程作業。七兄弟繼承父業, 各司其職。在這個高風險行業, 每天都是挑戰, 而裴勒提爾伐木公司正面臨經營危機。由於緬因州降下破紀錄雨量, 嚴重影響伐木和運材產量。主管營運的老二魯迪和員工想趕上進度, 卻弄巧成拙。魯迪派兒子傑森擔當危險的重要任務, 修復被山洪沖走的橋樑, 以便運出對岸幾百車的木材。但是兩輛運材卡車卻先後發生車禍。雖然駕駛都幸運生還, 但車禍不僅影響運材進度, 還造成公司虧損。如果情況持續下去, 公司將面臨裁員或停工的命運。為了維持公司生計, 家族成員和忠心耿耿的老員工每天工作十多個小時, 駕著笨重的運材卡車長途奔馳於美國和加拿大邊境間。

programme.title: Junkyard Empire S2E7 -Trucked Out
programme.desc: Andy, Bobby and their team of quirky characters find the proverbial diamonds in the rough, chase down deals, and add value to what others throw away.

programme.title: 第7集 - 小車不簡單
programme.desc: 安迪的老客戶找上門, 希望將一輛軍用兩噸半卡車改裝成露營車。問題是客戶三週後就要拿到, 還好安迪老爸鮑比提供了錦囊妙計, 讓他們趕在期限內交貨。鮑比找到一輛狀況良好的哈雷邊車, 想裝在安迪的舊警用機車上, 他去請哈雷專家朗恩幫忙, 在朗恩的巧手改造下, 機車煥然一新。安迪找到罕見的H1悍馬車底盤, 打算重新改造之後轉賣, 來大賺一筆。

programme.title: Super Street Garage S1E9 -Throwing It Back With A Tired Datsun Wagon
programme.desc: Old-school JDM rides have never been hotter, which is why Amir and Nads build a 1970 510, before meeting some OG Super Streeters for a historic parade cruise.

programme.title: 第9集 - 達特桑旅行車
programme.desc: 超級街道車廠這次要改裝一輛古色的復古達特桑旅行車, 帶著它登上舉辦在洛杉磯小東京的日本二世週節慶遊行活動。

programme.title: Smoked S1E2 -King Of Ribs
programme.desc: Georgia Rib specialists Brad Sweet and Lonnie Smith have turned to Myron Mixon to settle their rivalry once and for all.

programme.title: 第2集 - 肋排霸主
programme.desc: 老派作風的隆尼史密斯, 將迎戰新派作風的布萊德史維特, 證明誰才是喬治亞的肋排大王。

programme.title: Swamp Loggers S2E6 -All In
programme.desc: As conditions on Buckle tract improve, Bobby goes to Las Vegas to buy equipment. And growing concerns that the crew is gambling with their health, sees Bobby take action.

programme.title: 第6集 - 冒險賭注
programme.desc: 鮑比和賈斯汀想買一輛新的維修卡車, 但他們希望卡車能有四輪驅動系統所以去賭城參觀工程展, 打算買一套四驅系統, 他們看了四驅系統, 決定第二天去試車。他們不在的時候, 伐木團隊達到了一週出一百車的目標, 於是吃大餐慶祝。主廚的大衛有鑑於波的遭遇, 決定多做一些健康料理, 但是大夥似乎不太領情, 鮑比安排醫療團隊到巴克地來幫大家體來, 結果發現幾乎每個人的健康都有問題。

programme.title: Airplane Repo S2E4 -Panic At 10,000
programme.desc: Over the skies of North Texas, Kevin and Heather have grabbed themselves a Learjet.

programme.title: 第4集 - 高空驚魂
programme.desc: 本集三名飛機追追追專家繼續各自任務。凱文雷西與他的新學生剛偷走一架一百萬美元的李爾噴射機, 但是在高空3048公尺引擎斷油了, 而且他們正衝進雷暴中, 他們要怎麼化險為夷?飛機收回幹員丹尼湯普森大翹班, 拋下肯凱吉, 去執行賞金獵人的任務, 使肯在執行危險任務, 面對前科累累的債務人時, 少了人身保護。麥克甘迺迪深入山中尋一架昂貴的水上飛機, 但是缺乏燃料以及可以安全降落的水面之下, 他要如何脫困?精采內容敬請收看本集飛機追追追。

programme.title: 第12集 - 盛夏精選美味
programme.desc: The Kitchen is making dishes featuring summer's best produce, like Easy Grilled Tuna with Blackberry Glaze and Minty Grilled Asparagus Salad, Berry Tiramisu.

programme.title: 第5集 - 船上晚餐
programme.desc: 本集的主題是船上晚餐, 吉婭達與尚恩要跟友人進行航遊約會夜, 為此吉婭達準備了高雅又美味的晚餐, 包括甜菜沙拉搭配布拉塔乳酪、香煎鮭魚佐白酒朝鮮薊、蘑菇開心果水管麵以及誘人的甜點聖酒烤草莓, 美味的餐點配上動人的夕陽譜成美好的約會夜。

programme.title: 第6集 - 週間特製晚餐
programme.desc: 本集節目的主題是與潔德的女孩之夜, 和女兒獨處的晚餐食光, 就要吃女兒最愛的食物。首先要做可愛的櫻桃杏仁指模餅, 接著主食是濃郁帕瑪森乳酪烤義大利麵, 不但有青花椰菜點綴還有最美味的脆皮。還有義大利風的肉丸搭配芝麻菜沙拉, 以及簡單美味的煎炒四季豆。

programme.title: 第5集 - 雞蛋檔案
programme.desc: 本集美味秘訣升級版, 主持人回顧過去於1999年介紹雞蛋的集數。向觀眾解釋雞蛋的分級、內部構造, 以及三種蛋料理的改良烹調方式－煎蛋、炒蛋, 以及水煮蛋。主持人也指出, 90年代時人們普遍認為, 食用生雞蛋會導致沙門氏菌感染, 但現在的雞蛋經過消毒, 不再需要擔心。

programme.title: 第6集 - 扁的最美第二集
programme.desc: 主持人在本集節目中要傳授將肉拍平的祕訣, 並示範如何將扁平肉排做成皮卡塔和基輔雞等美味肉排料理。

programme.title: 第13集 - 培根蛋麵
programme.desc: 在本集節目裡, 瑞秋的老公約翰來到節目上跟她一起下廚, 約翰要負責用琴酒、金巴利、紅苦艾酒及苦精等食材調出內格羅尼酒, 同時瑞秋也著手製作約翰最愛的培根蛋麵, 但這回會稍有變化, 加入帝王蟹腳肉, 做成蟹肉蛋麵。不過在蟹肉下鍋之前, 得先動手檢查蟹肉裡是否有碎殼或軟骨。瑞秋也示範如何用富含澱粉的鹹煮麵水為蛋黃及乳酪調溫, 做出培根蛋麵該有的黏稠度, 調好的醬汁加上甘甜的蟹肉, 加點新英格蘭風味的老灣調味料, 最後再撒上切碎的芹菜葉來為菜餚畫龍點睛, 這道菜的滋味令瑞秋跟約翰連聲叫好。

programme.title: 第14集 - 肉排料理
programme.desc: 在本集節目裡, 瑞秋要做日式炸豬排, 她發現只要做成肉片, 無論是酥炸肉排或帕瑪乳酪烤雞排, 往往都會大獲好評。她先開始使用烏斯特黑醋、番茄醬、醬油、芥末粉、蒜粒與味醂調製出美味可口的醬汁, 接著準備好裹料的烤盤, 把豬腰肉排打扁後裹上日式麵包粉、蛋液及芝麻, 用中性油下鍋炸得酥香可口, 淋上已經做好的醬汁, 讓她免了去日式餐廳排對外帶回家吃的麻煩, 在家就能享用這道美食。她接著把皺葉甘藍切絲, 加上蘿蔔片與紫蘇絲, 做了一道速成的沙拉, 淋上溜醬油及蜂蜜做成的醬汁, 味道非常甘甜。

programme.title: 第25集 - 亞利桑那州斯科次代爾
programme.desc: 本集凱西偉伯來到亞利桑那州的斯科次代爾, 品嘗超狂早午餐、可以客製化的吉拿棒, 最後挑戰在三十分鐘內, 吃完一般人要花一整天才吃得完的熟食套餐。

programme.title: 第26集 - 科羅拉多州丹佛
programme.desc: 在本集節目中, 主持人凱西來到丹佛, 他將品嘗丹佛小麵包公司的特色小麵包三明治, 見識薯餅之愛餐廳的猶太風薯餅料理, 並征服山姆三號店, 重達1.8公斤的早餐怪獸。他是否能在30分鐘內挑戰成功呢?鎖定本節目觀賞精彩內容。

programme.desc: Guy Fieri challenges the competitors to leave the plates behind and serve everything in a bowl.

programme.title: 第2集 - 閃擊歐陸
programme.desc: 在擊敗波蘭之後, 希特勒把目光轉向西方, 計畫對法國發動攻擊, 並準備利用法軍防線中的薄弱環節。英國首相邱吉爾則急忙設法撤離盟軍部隊。

programme.desc: In Onjeong Market, located in Onjeong, a town some distance away from Seoul, the area is buzzing with change as apartment complexes are built and plans for subway extensions and new town developments are announced. Across a single street stand a principled general hospital, Gongmyeongjeongdae Clinic, and traditional Korean clinic, Yangji Barun Clinic. The two families who run these places have been bitter enemies for years, bound by a long standing grudge from an incident in the past. Even the smallest matters turn into big fights, making them the most famous rival families in Onjeong. This is a family growth drama about these two families as they unravel their long held misunderstandings, heal their wounds, learn to love one another, and are reborn as one family.

programme.title: Jang Youngsil: The Greatest Scientist Of Joseon E21
programme.desc: The drama is the first 'historic science' drama that has been produced in Korea. This drama depicts the successful life story of the scientist Jang Youngsil that contributed to the development and accomplishment of Joseon's science during the 15th century. In particular, the drama emphasizes his accomplishment through showing the restrictions and difficulties he experienced due to his social class as a slave. Moreover, the drama aims to depict Jang Youngsil as the role model of 'Korea's youth of the 21st century' through displaying his scientific accomplishments. The drama also expects to stimulate scientific curiosity amongst audiences and help them easily understand the fundamental principles of science by utilizing various data and scientific videos.

programme.desc: In this episode, host Michael Yo takes viewers on five mind-blowing dining adventures that push the limits of imagination and exceed all culinary expectations!

programme.title: 第2集 - 感官超載
programme.desc: 在本集中, 主持人麥可.優 (Michael Yo) 將帶領觀眾展開五場令人震撼的用餐冒險, 挑戰想像的邊界, 突破所有對美食的既定期待!這不只是一次環遊世界的饗宴, 更是一場關於創意、勇氣與感官的終極考驗。

programme.title: Zombie House Flipping S5E69 -Tampa: Grace
programme.desc: The team scores a major deal when Dolmar is offered a low-price on a home in a desirable neighbourhood in South Tampa. After some debate, the decision is made to turn the home into a long-term rental.

programme.title: 第69集 - 坦帕: 格蕾絲
programme.desc: 團隊在本集成功進行了一宗重大交易: 有人以低價向多爾馬出售一棟位於南坦帕理想街區的房子。經過一番討論, 團隊決定將這棟房屋改造成長期出租房。

programme.title: Casting 1147Km E4
programme.desc: The second romance mission challenges the actors to reinterpret legendary performances by Eric (Another Miss Oh) and Son Suk-ku (My Liberation Notes), bringing their own unique perspectives to the scripts.

programme.title: 第4集
programme.desc: 第二項愛情任務, 要考驗演員們以自己的獨特視角, 重新詮釋艾瑞克在《又, 吳海英》以及孫錫久 (Son Suk-ku) 在《我的出走日記》中的經典演出, 為這些劇本帶入各自不同的理解與表現。

programme.title: Enlighten Your Life S3E2
programme.desc: With growing interest in nature-friendly interiors, today's homes are all about nature-friendly elements. We'll introduce you to the 'Smart House in Nature' and the extraordinary 'Eco-Friendly Open House'.

programme.title: 第2集
programme.desc: 隨著人們對自然友好設計風格漸感興趣, 如今最流行的家居裝潢都充滿了自然元素。本集將為觀眾介紹一個滿有自然原素的的智能家居, 以及一個非凡的環保開放居所。

programme.title: Rachael Ray's Meals In Minutes S2E23 -Spaghetti With Semi-Dried Tomato Pesto & Broccolini With Sausages
programme.desc: Semi-dried tomatoes are a new staple in American grocery stores. Rachael demonstrates how to use them as the star in her recipe for a pesto paired with broccolini and served with sausage.

programme.title: 第23集 - 番茄青醬義麵與香腸青花菜
programme.desc: 半乾番茄如今已成為美國超市中常見的新興主角。瑞秋示範如何將這種風味濃縮、介於鮮番茄與乾番茄之間的食材, 打造成一道令人驚艷的主體醬料──搭配嫩脆的綠花椰菜與多汁香腸一同享用, 讓餐桌瞬間升級。

programme.title: Rachael Ray's Meals In Minutes S2E24 -Spicy Charred Tomato Pasta With Hot Sausage Or Chickpeas
programme.desc: Rachael shows us how to spice up a charred tomato sauce and pasta dinner in two ways. In one dish she's serving the pasta over sausage and in the other she pairs the pasta with chickpeas.

programme.title: 第24集 - 炙辣番茄義麵雙拼
programme.desc: 瑞秋這次帶來一場簡單卻不單調的番茄醬料理教學, 她以炙燒番茄製作出一款風味濃烈的醬汁, 再呈現兩種搭配方式: 一道是將醬汁淋在與香腸搭配的義大利麵上, 另一道則是結合鷹嘴豆與麵條, 做出口感截然不同的晚餐風貌。

programme.title: Zombie House Flipping S6E94 -Dallas: Whittenburg
programme.desc: Chauncey and Derek team up with Project Manager. But with giant holes in the floor, roaches, and all sorts of unspeakable muck, the budget and timeline quickly balloon.

programme.title: 第94集 - 達拉斯: 惠滕堡
programme.desc: 肖恩西和德里克與項目經理聯手, 埋頭規劃翻新工程。但地板上巨大的洞、蟑螂和各種難以形容的污物, 為預算和施工時間帶來難以估量的風險。

programme.title: Masterchef Australia S18E27
programme.desc: In today's episode of MasterChef Australia, five cooks in the bottom are facing a Time VS Ingredients elimination challenge and the bottom dish will send its maker home.

programme.title: 第27集
programme.desc: 在今天的《澳洲頂級廚師》一集中, 五位排名最底的廚師面臨著時間對抗食材的淘汰挑戰, 而最差的菜品將使其製作者被淘汰回家。

programme.title: Global Soul Kitchen S2E20 -Adobo Ribs
programme.desc: Chef Deborah brings a Filipino classic to life with her adobo baby back ribs and pancit noodles, each with a Southern twist and inspired by a chef in Atlanta. She marinates the ribs and pan-fries them.

programme.title: 第20集 - 阿多波豬肋排
programme.desc: 主廚黛博拉以她的阿多波風味豬肋排與炒米粉, 讓一道經典的菲律賓料理鮮活呈現。這兩道菜各自加入了南方料理的變化靈感, 並受到亞特蘭大一位主廚的啟發。她先將豬肋排醃漬入味, 接著再以平底鍋煎至表面香酥。

programme.title: One Night Stand Murder
programme.desc: A woman must fight to clear her name after she wakes up in an unfamiliar house with a dead man - and no memory of what happened. Based on true events.

programme.title: 一夜情殺案
programme.desc: 一名女子在陌生的房間中醒來, 赫然發現旁邊有一具死屍--而她對所發生的事情毫無記憶。她必須用盡一切方法證明自己清白。電影根據真實事件改編。

programme.title: Masterchef Australia S18E27
programme.desc: In today's episode of MasterChef Australia, five cooks in the bottom are facing a Time VS Ingredients elimination challenge and the bottom dish will send its maker home.

programme.title: 第27集
programme.desc: 在今天的《澳洲頂級廚師》一集中, 五位排名最底的廚師面臨著時間對抗食材的淘汰挑戰, 而最差的菜品將使其製作者被淘汰回家。

programme.title: Coral City S1E4 -Winter
programme.desc: Get chills as winter descends, slowing down life on the bustling reef. Meander with reef sharks and octopuses, visit a coral oasis atop an old shipwreck, and spot a banded snake eel’s talent for identity theft when it disguises itself as a predator.

programme.title: 第4集 - 寒冬
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​當寒冬降臨之際，沁入骨髓的寒意讓原本熱鬧喧騰的珊瑚礁世界趨於沉靜。隨著鏡頭悠然緩行，你將與礁鯊一同漫遊，與章魚共度水下時光；還會探訪一處奇妙的珊瑚綠洲，靜靜地矗立在一艘古老船骸之上。別錯過條紋蛇鰻高超的「身分竊取」本領：牠能巧妙偽裝成兇猛的掠食者，以迷惑周遭的生物。

programme.title: Pride Rules S1E2 -Adapt Or Die
programme.desc: Feel the heat when the pride tries to hunt down adequate food as drought conditions push them (and their prey) dangerously close to death. Watch Einstein adapt to solo life, then assess the damage after new mom Kalwezi fights for her cubs’ lives.

programme.title: 第2集 - 適者生存
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​感受炙熱高溫，當獅群努力狩獵足夠食物，乾旱條件逼迫他們與獵物一同陷入接近死亡的險境，生命幾乎被推向邊緣。觀看愛因斯坦適應孤獨生活，然後評估戰場殘局，在新手母親卡爾維茲為幼崽性命而奮戰之後。

programme.title: Osprey: Sea Raptor
programme.desc: Wade into a saltwater marsh along the Connecticut River to witness the heartwarming reunion of two ospreys who’ve been mates for a decade. Witness their highs and lows over a single summer as they raise their chicks and dodge a host of predators.

programme.title: 魚鷹: 海洋迅猛禽
programme.desc: 一對老魚鷹回到康州鹽沼的家中。牠們在整個夏天必須與敵人作戰，忍耐惡劣天氣，捕獵千百條魚，只為養育下一代。

programme.title: Africa's Hunters S3E6 -Buffalo Showdown
programme.desc: To the lion, the buffalo is not only a satisfying dinner but also dangerous. Track a herd of 300 buffalo along with the Mwamba pride, who must act quickly and carefully if they are to take down their prey.

programme.title: 第6集 - 水牛對決
programme.desc: 對獅子來說，水牛固然是令人滿足的晚餐，但同時也是危險的獵物。與穆瓦姆巴獅群一起追蹤為數近三百頭水牛，並從中窺探他們的獵食技巧，他們必須迅速而謹慎地行動。

programme.title: The Great Elephant Tale
programme.desc: Follow the adventures of three elephants across three very distinct African habitats. Their travels combine to tell the story of how these emotional and intelligent creatures evolved over millions of years to survive on the continent.

programme.title: 大象傳奇
programme.desc: 《大象傳奇》有三個故事。一頭牛犢穿越奧卡萬戈三角洲。一頭公牛正尋覓伴侶。一位女族長帶領家人穿過沙漠。這些個別的冒險故事一同敍述了非洲最具標誌性物種之一的故事。

programme.title: Aussie Snake Wranglers: Deadly Pursuit S2E1 -Three's a Crowd
programme.desc: Get tangled up in breeding season with Mick and Adele, who save a Jack Russell from a peckish python. Make a splash with Mick as he corners a deadly red-bellied black snake in a pool, and tackle eastern browns at a construction site with Stu and Liv.

programme.title: 第1集 - 三人行
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​在繁殖季節中與米克和阿黛爾一起糾纏不清，他們救了一隻被饑餓的蟒蛇威脅的傑克羅素犬。與米克一起在泳池中對抗一條致命的紅腹黑蛇，並與斯圖和莉芙一起在建築工地上處理東部棕蛇。

programme.title: Aussie Snake Wranglers: Deadly Pursuit S2E2 -Double Trouble
programme.desc: Gear up for a steamy rescue when Dan and Jess remove mating eastern browns from a backyard, then hold your breath as Mick sniffs out a highly venomous snake inside a couch cushion. Later, watch Stu cut up a chicken coop to pry out a carpet python.

programme.title: 第2集 - 雙重麻煩
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​準備好進行一場火熱的救援，當丹和傑絲從後院移除交配中的東部棕蛇時，然後屏住呼吸，因為米克在沙發墊裡嗅出了一條高度有毒的蛇。稍後，觀看斯圖拆解一個雞舍以撬出一條地毯蟒蛇。

programme.title: Coral City S1E3 -Autumn
programme.desc: Adapt or perish in the coral streets as higher-than-normal temperatures make autumn cooling (and survival) more difficult. Shack up with a clownfish family and their sea anemone landlord, then see cleaner fish give manta rays a day at the spa.

programme.title: 第3集 - 秋天
programme.desc: ​在珊瑚街道中，生存從來不是理所當然，唯有適應，否則就得滅亡。​高於常態的溫度使得入秋冷卻變得更加困難，生存難度隨之攀升。暫住於小丑魚一家和他們那位海葵房東之間的共生之家，再看看清潔魚如何替魔鬼魟提供一場猶如水中溫泉會館般的療癒服務。

programme.title: Superbeast S1E2 -Super Speed
programme.desc: Hit the gas with Earth’s fastest animal athletes. Watch death adders strike in the blink of an eye, do airborne assassinations with peregrine falcons, catch a quick meal with chameleons, and face breakneck G-forces as gannets dive-bomb their prey.

programme.title: 第2集 - 超級速度
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與地球上最快的動物運動員一起加速。觀看死亡加德蛇在瞬間出擊，與遊隼一起進行空中暗殺，與變色龍一起捕捉快速的食物，並面對在海雀俯衝獵物時的驚人G力。

programme.desc: 《大象傳奇》有三個故事。一頭牛犢穿越奧卡萬戈三角洲。一頭公牛正尋覓伴侶。一位女族長帶領家人穿過沙漠。這些個別的冒險故事一同敍述了非洲最具標誌性物種之一的故事。

programme.title: Aussie Snake Wranglers: Deadly Pursuit S2E1 -Three's a Crowd
programme.desc: Get tangled up in breeding season with Mick and Adele, who save a Jack Russell from a peckish python. Make a splash with Mick as he corners a deadly red-bellied black snake in a pool, and tackle eastern browns at a construction site with Stu and Liv.

programme.title: 第1集 - 三人行
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​在繁殖季節中與米克和阿黛爾一起糾纏不清，他們救了一隻被饑餓的蟒蛇威脅的傑克羅素犬。與米克一起在泳池中對抗一條致命的紅腹黑蛇，並與斯圖和莉芙一起在建築工地上處理東部棕蛇。

programme.title: Aussie Snake Wranglers: Deadly Pursuit S2E2 -Double Trouble
programme.desc: Gear up for a steamy rescue when Dan and Jess remove mating eastern browns from a backyard, then hold your breath as Mick sniffs out a highly venomous snake inside a couch cushion. Later, watch Stu cut up a chicken coop to pry out a carpet python.

programme.title: 第2集 - 雙重麻煩
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​準備好進行一場火熱的救援，當丹和傑絲從後院移除交配中的東部棕蛇時，然後屏住呼吸，因為米克在沙發墊裡嗅出了一條高度有毒的蛇。稍後，觀看斯圖拆解一個雞舍以撬出一條地毯蟒蛇。

programme.title: Coral City S1E3 -Autumn
programme.desc: Adapt or perish in the coral streets as higher-than-normal temperatures make autumn cooling (and survival) more difficult. Shack up with a clownfish family and their sea anemone landlord, then see cleaner fish give manta rays a day at the spa.

programme.title: 第3集 - 秋天
programme.desc: ​在珊瑚街道中，生存從來不是理所當然，唯有適應，否則就得滅亡。​高於常態的溫度使得入秋冷卻變得更加困難，生存難度隨之攀升。暫住於小丑魚一家和他們那位海葵房東之間的共生之家，再看看清潔魚如何替魔鬼魟提供一場猶如水中溫泉會館般的療癒服務。

programme.title: Coral City S1E4 -Winter
programme.desc: Get chills as winter descends, slowing down life on the bustling reef. Meander with reef sharks and octopuses, visit a coral oasis atop an old shipwreck, and spot a banded snake eel’s talent for identity theft when it disguises itself as a predator.

programme.title: 第4集 - 寒冬
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​當寒冬降臨之際，沁入骨髓的寒意讓原本熱鬧喧騰的珊瑚礁世界趨於沉靜。隨著鏡頭悠然緩行，你將與礁鯊一同漫遊，與章魚共度水下時光；還會探訪一處奇妙的珊瑚綠洲，靜靜地矗立在一艘古老船骸之上。別錯過條紋蛇鰻高超的「身分竊取」本領：牠能巧妙偽裝成兇猛的掠食者，以迷惑周遭的生物。

programme.title: Pride Rules S1E2 -Adapt Or Die
programme.desc: Feel the heat when the pride tries to hunt down adequate food as drought conditions push them (and their prey) dangerously close to death. Watch Einstein adapt to solo life, then assess the damage after new mom Kalwezi fights for her cubs’ lives.

programme.title: 第2集 - 適者生存
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​感受炙熱高溫，當獅群努力狩獵足夠食物，乾旱條件逼迫他們與獵物一同陷入接近死亡的險境，生命幾乎被推向邊緣。觀看愛因斯坦適應孤獨生活，然後評估戰場殘局，在新手母親卡爾維茲為幼崽性命而奮戰之後。

programme.title: Osprey: Sea Raptor
programme.desc: Wade into a saltwater marsh along the Connecticut River to witness the heartwarming reunion of two ospreys who’ve been mates for a decade. Witness their highs and lows over a single summer as they raise their chicks and dodge a host of predators.

programme.title: 魚鷹: 海洋迅猛禽
programme.desc: 一對老魚鷹回到康州鹽沼的家中。牠們在整個夏天必須與敵人作戰，忍耐惡劣天氣，捕獵千百條魚，只為養育下一代。

programme.title: Africa's Hunters S3E6 -Buffalo Showdown
programme.desc: To the lion, the buffalo is not only a satisfying dinner but also dangerous. Track a herd of 300 buffalo along with the Mwamba pride, who must act quickly and carefully if they are to take down their prey.

programme.title: 第6集 - 水牛對決
programme.desc: 對獅子來說，水牛固然是令人滿足的晚餐，但同時也是危險的獵物。與穆瓦姆巴獅群一起追蹤為數近三百頭水牛，並從中窺探他們的獵食技巧，他們必須迅速而謹慎地行動。

programme.title: The Great Elephant Tale

programme.title: Superbeast S1E2 -Super Speed
programme.desc: Hit the gas with Earth’s fastest animal athletes. Watch death adders strike in the blink of an eye, do airborne assassinations with peregrine falcons, catch a quick meal with chameleons, and face breakneck G-forces as gannets dive-bomb their prey.

programme.title: 第2集 - 超級速度
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與地球上最快的動物運動員一起加速。觀看死亡加德蛇在瞬間出擊，與遊隼一起進行空中暗殺，與變色龍一起捕捉快速的食物，並面對在海雀俯衝獵物時的驚人G力。

programme.desc: It's the ultimate showdown between Arpo & his arch-nemesis, the Squirrel! The trouble multiplies when the squirrel uses a ray gun to create an army of clones that fills the house. Then, the battle for food continues as the squirrel tries to steal a freshly baked apple pie & tasty food from a picnic BBQ. The showdown gets truly bizarre when the squirrel gets trapped inside Arpo & takes control of the robot's body, causing all sorts of confusing chaos for the family!

programme.desc: Get ready for some total mayhem caused by Baby Daniel! Then, Arpo is tasked with cleaning the kitchen, but Daniel just wants to play, making an even bigger mess. From getting covered in mud to being extra noisy while Daddy is trying to sleep, Baby Daniel keeps Arpo on his toes in this fun-filled, chaotic adventure!

programme.desc: 《小寶貝布姆》講述了米雅、Twinkle the Star 和 Baby Max 的音樂冒險故事。像是洗澡、穿衣或玩躲貓貓這類日常時刻，加上新的和經典的兒歌就會變得更有樂趣。

programme.desc: Get arty with Little Baby Bum this August! Help Mia and her friends paint a huge mural of The Bus. Then, bake yummy muffins with Rose, play BINGO with the whole family, and have a dino-tastic snack time in a pretend Dinosaur Cafe!

programme.desc: Get ready for the most unpredictable magic mishaps! First, Magic Pet Chroma accidentally takes away all the colors from the city, & Morphle must morph into a magic paintbrush to paint them all back. Then, Professor Paula's new youth serum is accidentally spilled on Mila, turning her into a baby! Now Morphle has to look after baby Mila while an antidote is created. The mishaps continue as giant bubbles carry away citizens & a giant living doll causes chaos!

programme.desc: 《My Magic Pet Morphle》講述米拉和她的魔法變形動物莫福的冒險。不論是需要阻止一個不知道如何控制魔力的魔法動物、鎮裡的壞蛋偷東西或是頑皮的奧福搞破壞，米拉和莫福總是會一起努力幫忙！

programme.desc: It's story time with JJ's favorite songs & stories! First, sing along to 'Wheels on the Bus' as JJ & his friends put on an interactive show. Then, settle in for some classic tales. Watch as the three little pigs try to build houses strong enough to keep the Big Bad Wolf away. Then, find out who wins a big race: the speedy hare or the slow & steady tortoise! Finally, learn a lesson about working hard with the story of the Grasshopper & the Ants.

programme.title: 第9集 - 傑傑最愛的歌曲與故事！
programme.desc: 載歌載舞的時間到了！加入傑傑、他的親朋好友一起慶祝小朋友生命中的重要時刻。來一起加他們的日常冒險。

programme.title: Dance Party S2E1 -Learn & Dance with JJ's Animal Pals!
programme.desc: It's a learning dance party with JJ's animal pals! First, learn all about vowels with the fun & silly song 'Apples & Bananas.' Then, get ready to count as you dance with dinosaurs & countdown from five to one. The learning continues as you guess what sounds different animals make & bounce like rabbits, frogs & kangaroos on a trampoline! Plus, you can even learn to sing 'Itsy Bitsy Spider' entirely in Spanish with Nina!

programme.title: 第1集 - 和傑傑的動物夥伴一起學習與跳舞！
programme.desc: 傑傑和所有 Melon Patch 孩子們在可可瓜舞台上隨著他們最喜歡的兒歌起舞。他們全部的動物好友都在跳著舞；你何不一起加入呢？

programme.title: Minibods S1E1 -Fruits, Cupcakes, Snacks & Ice Cream!
programme.desc: It's a day of yummy adventures with fruits, cupcakes, snacks & ice cream! Pogo wants to pick a delicious fruit from a tree, but he hilariously learns that he has to be patient & wait for it to ripen! Then, Lulu is determined to bake a cupcake all by herself, but her mixture turns into a giant cupcake blob that takes over the Playpod! Plus, Fuse is craving a snack but can't get the box open & Pogo's ice cream keeps melting!

programme.title: 第1集 - 水果、杯子蛋糕、小點心與冰淇淋！
programme.desc: 歡迎來到 Bod 這顆奇幻的星球，這裡也是迷你萌兵的家。加入六位毛茸茸的小夥伴一起搞笑搗蛋，將日常情況變成意想不到的超愚蠢事件。無論生活如何，迷你萌兵都會以非傳統的方式克服障礙，並更好地了解自己和週遭的世界。

programme.title: Minibods S1E3 -A Sick Trick, A Spider, A Bump & A Fly!
programme.desc: The Minibods are dealing with a sick trick, a spider, a bump & a fly! First, Jeff is sick, but after he recovers, he misses the attention & pretends he's still unwell! Then, Fuse is woken up by spooky noises in the night & must put on a brave face for Lulu to investigate. His bravery is tested again when he finds a spider in his gym & doesn't know how to get it out. The chaos ends when Pogo can't sleep & has to deal with a very noisy fly!

programme.title: 第3集 - 小把戲、蜘蛛、撞到頭與小飛蟲！
programme.desc: 歡迎來到 Bod 這顆奇幻的星球，這裡也是迷你萌兵的家。加入六位毛茸茸的小夥伴一起搞笑搗蛋，將日常情況變成意想不到的超愚蠢事件。無論生活如何，迷你萌兵都會以非傳統的方式克服障礙，並更好地了解自己和週遭的世界。

programme.title: Blippi Wonders S3E1 -From Dinosaurs To Pet Knights!
programme.desc: Blippi is on an adventure from dinosaurs to pet knights! He travels back in time with Tabbs to help a little Microraptor prove that being small has its benefits when they rescue a giant sauropod from the mud. Then, they head to the African savannah to learn how to roar, sneak & pounce like a lion! Back at the clubhouse, Blippi learns how to interpret a puppy's tail wags & even travels back in time again to help a real-life knight in shining armor—who happens to be a corgi!

programme.title: 第1集 - 恐龍與小騎士大冒險！
programme.desc: 與比利皮一起搭乘他的 BlippiMobile 踏上有趣的冒險，回答像是「彩虹是怎麼拿到自己的顏色？」 以及「為什麼比利皮的冰棒會融化？」這類十萬火急的問題。幸運的是，他有可靠的夥伴 TABBS 和迪寶幫助他找到答案。

programme.title: Blippi Wonders S3E4 -A Guide To Fun & Healthy Days!
programme.desc: Blippi is your guide to having fun & healthy days! First, have some fun in the sun while learning from Señor Super Sunscreen how to apply sunscreen properly. Then, shrink down with Blippi & Meekah as they travel to Italy to learn how to make an authentic pizza! The adventure continues as Blippi helps a bear get ready for winter hibernation. After a long day of fun, it's time for bed, as a magical book reads a bedtime story about the benefits of a good night's rest!

programme.title: 第4集 - 教你如何開心又健康！
programme.desc: 與比利皮一起搭乘他的 BlippiMobile 踏上有趣的冒險，回答像是「彩虹是怎麼拿到自己的顏色？」 以及「為什麼比利皮的冰棒會融化？」這類十萬火急的問題。幸運的是，他有可靠的夥伴 TABBS 和迪寶幫助他找到答案。

programme.title: Blippi Wonders S1E1 -An Ultimate Animal Adventure!
programme.desc: Blippi is wondering about animals on an ultimate adventure! Join Blippi & his robot friend FETCH as they travel the world to get their questions answered. How high can a kangaroo jump? Blippi finds out in a hopping race in Australia! How do bats see in the dark? A new bat friend shows him all about echolocation! The adventure continues as he learns why squirrels bury nuts & how ducks float. Blippi & FETCH also help their new friends, like when they work together to rebuild a blue jay's nest!

programme.title: 第1集 - 超級動物大冒險！

programme.title: The Creature Cases S1E114 -The Frozen Stowaways/The Puzzle Of The Empty Pond
programme.desc: The Stinkwells send Sam and Kit a strange and crawly case trapped in ice. // A salamander mom wonders why her dry pond hasn't filled up with water.

programme.title: The Creature Cases S1E115 -The Undercover Hyena/The Stranger In The Burrow
programme.desc: Sam tries to blend in with a tough clan of hyenas during a desert mission. // Underground creatures start getting spooked by their burrow's new addition.

programme.title: Deer Squad S3E312 -Bats All Folks/The Handbag Of Doom
programme.desc: Scratch's holiday to the Secret Island goes awry when the noise from her tablet threatens the rare bat's visit to the island. // Lady Fluffpot gets Prof Scratch to increase her handbag storage - but Scratch's widget sucks in everything around it.

programme.title: Peppa Pig S8E838 -Detective Potato
programme.desc: Peppa and George are watching Detective Potato on television. When Daddy loses his car in the car park, Detective Potato appears and saves the day!

programme.title: Peppa Pig S8E839 -The Electric Car
programme.desc: Daddy Pig arrives in a new electric car. The family all go for a ride and are surprised when the car talks and sings!

programme.title: Peppa Pig S8E840 -Stone Age Granny
programme.desc: Granny and her friends' historical re-enactment society are being cave people today. Peppa and George join in helping to catch Grandpa Pig who is dressed as a woolly mammoth.

programme.title: Peppa Pig S8E841 -Space Adventure!
programme.desc: Peppa and George are re-enacting the Apollo Moon Landing with the help of Granny Pig's historical re-enactment society. Grampy Rabbit has lent them his rocket, but no one has told him it's just pretend.

programme.title: Ben & Holly's Little Kingdom S1E115 -The Ant Hill/Redbeard The Elf Pirate
programme.desc: Things start to go missing all over the kingdom, and Ben & Holly realise that ants are stealing their possessions. // Barnaby Elf's uncle Redbeard has lost all his treasure, prompting Holly & Ben to follow the clues in an effort to track it down.

programme.title: Paw Patrol S8E825 -Rubble And Wild And A Yarn Ball!/Skye And Rory Flip It/Marshall, Leo An
programme.desc: Rubble & Wild rescue animals from a giant runaway ball of yarn. // Skye and Rory rescue a painter hanging from a scaffold. // Marshall & Leo rescue animals stuck on a Ferris Wheel.// Everest and Shade rescue a baby mountain goat stuck in a crevasse.

programme.title: Paw Patrol S11E1104 -Pups Save Helga And The Humsquatch
programme.desc: Mayor Humdinger is getting dressed for a special day with his Hummy Mummy.

programme.title: Rubble & Crew S2E221 -The Crew Builds A Winter Wonderland/The Crew Builds A Giant Snow Squirrel
programme.desc: Rubble & Crew work together to transform Builder Cove's beach boardwalk into a bright, festive winter wonderland. // When a snow day gets in the way of Motor & Mix's Super Squirrely Whirly plans, Rubble & Crew do what they do best... build!

programme.title: Rubble & Crew S1E114 -The Crew Builds A Splash Park
programme.desc: With their splash park plans in troubled waters, the pups have to get creative to cool down the town for the summer.

programme.title: Mr. Crocodile S1E109 -Borrower Daisy/Can Do Croc
programme.desc: Mr. Crocodile and Daisy try to figure out which of her friends borrowed her game and didn't return it. // A perfect 'Step-Mother's' day for Maggie all depends on Daisy and Mr. Crocodile finding a can opener.

programme.title: Barbapapa - One Big Happy Family! S2E206 -The Birth/The Revelation
programme.desc: Young Francois witnesses the birth of Barbapapa. // Barbapapa is a prisoner in a zoo.

programme.title: Barbapapa - One Big Happy Family! S1E101 -The Barbapapa Tree
programme.desc: Barbapapa and Barbamama return to the tree they were born under. It's in bad condition. They must rescue it quickly without disturbing the nearby animals

programme.title: Dora S2E205 -Crabby Wedding/The Cloud Kingdom
programme.desc: Dora's crab friends are getting married but Swiper swipes the ring and loses it in the ocean. Dora has to get the ring back! / Dora and Boots meet Vicky the Vicuna who is missing her magic flute that she needs to go back to the Cloud Kingdom.

programme.title: Life is Beautiful
programme.desc: Suddenly learning she is terminally ill, 'Se-yeon' asks her husband, 'Jin-bong', the absurd task of helping her find her first love, and he unwillingly joins her search. Along their journey, 'Se-yeon' and 'Jin-bong' are reminded of the most glittering, beautiful moments of their lives.

programme.title: Three
programme.desc: Zhau is a young doctor who desperately needs a successful operation on a high-profile patient to redeem a previous failure which not only cost the life of a patient but her self-esteem. Han is a suspect of multiple armed robberies and homicides, who has been taken to the hospital after being shot with a bullet in his head during a showdown with the police. Officer Lok is at first sight a gung-ho policeman who has participated in the showdown, but when he makes desperate attempts to do Han in by exploiting Zhau's weaknesses, it is apparent he is harboring a much darker secret...

programme.title: Baogu Produces -UFO Files: Behind the Madness
programme.desc: Filmed in just eleven days, the low-budget production “Unidentified Murder” saw a massive burst of creativity from both the cast and crew; the actors' improvisations kept the set filled with laughter. In this Interview, the creative team is invited to share their production process and reveal the chaotic, unpredictable moments the crew experienced while filming up on the hill.

programme.title: The Dead Dumpster
programme.desc: Gang of friends who never thought to do any good things, get luck by winning lotto. They bring all money to casino with hope it will be increased but get a huge debt instead. They decide to rob a car without knowing that there is a dead body inside. Their mission turns into 2, escape from police as suspected murderers and they have to get away from owner of the casino.

programme.title: Confession
programme.desc: Min-ho's adulterous lover Se-hee is murdered in the hotel where the two of them spent time together. Apart from Min-ho, there is no trace of anyone else having been there. Immediately singled out as the prime suspect, Min-ho maintains his innocence, and he hires the lawyer Shin-ae, who has a 100% record of victory in court, to defend him. In order to prove his innocence, she asks Min-ho to confess to her the entire truth. He admits that a car accident that they were in the day before the murder may be connected in some way to Se-hee's death.

programme.title: Baogu At the Movie E262 -Night King
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: The Moment
programme.desc: 'The Moment' talks about four relationships - A couple breaking up yet holding tight; a father and a daughter meeting up after a long separation; a girl escaping from growing up; and two buddies' reunion after years of misunderstanding. Different people carry different stories. The stories are connected by a vintage photography studio holder. Their experiences bring out a variety of sensations to the city we are living in; these feelings belong to them, and also us.

programme.title: Summer Wars
programme.desc: Worlds collide in a tale where virtual reality meets actual reality. When Kenji Koiso is pulled from Oz, a popular social networking realm, to play fiance to classmate Natsuki, he faces a mess of challenges. Between the boisterous and bickering characters of the Jinnouchi clan and the sudden chaos in Oz, Kenji and his new companions must learn the importance of coming together to face the toughest of odds.

programme.title: CRISIS NEGOTIATORS
programme.desc: Negotiator expert Cheuk Man Wai unexpectedly becomes the prime suspect in a murder case. Forced into a corner, he occupies the police station, taking officers hostage, and demands negotiations with the former negotiator Tse Ka Chun. With Tse's expertise in psychological manipulation and Cheuk's exceptional skills, they engage in a battle of wits. As the verbal sparring deepens, their positions and mindsets gradually change...This film is adapted from the American movie 'The Negotiator'.

programme.title: Acting's No Kidding: The Hill of Secrets
programme.desc: Sensitive 12-year-old Myung-eun (Moon Seung-a) is embarrassed of her working-class family and constantly lies to keep her true family situation a secret. When she writes, though, she is not constrained by reality. Pouring herself into essays, Myung-eun takes pride in constructing a different world of her own. However, the candid writings of a new student shake her sense of self, and prompt Myung-eun to better understand her family. Reminiscent of acclaimed coming-of-age Korean indies like The World of Us and House of Hummingbird, writer-director Lee Ji-eun's understated debut feature excels in its perceptive depiction of the emotions and experiences of a child trying to find her place in the world.

programme.title: Baogu Select Music X Microfilm E265 -The Seventh Day
programme.desc: Late at night, Heyson returns home, stirring memories of his distant relationship with his father, Kingman. The story weaves between past and present: a child longing for companionship, a father trapped in work and regret. When Heyson's sexuality is unexpectedly exposed, years of tension erupt. After running out, he discovers their old “treasure box,” revealing forgotten warmth. Through this rediscovered memory, father and son finally face each other and begin to heal.

programme.title: Winners And Sinners
programme.desc: The five met in prison, Teapot, Exhaust Pipe, Vaseline, Curly Jack and Larry became friends and they would stay clean from now on. In fact they formed a cleaning company and worked hard at it after their release. Little did they realize they were released together with Boss Chan of the feared underworld who immediately reactivated his money counterfeit operation...

programme.title: Shanghai Grand
programme.desc: The Taiwan military officer, Hsu falls into the enemy's ambush, and floats to the Shanghai shore where he is saved by Ting Lik. Lik teams up with Kueng to try to make a fortune and soon they become famous in Shanghai. The Shanghai tycoon Fung try to eliminate other opponents with the help of Hsu and Lik. Later, Hsu discovers Fung is the mastermind of the ambush that killed all his fellow officials...

programme.title: Love For All Seasons
programme.desc: Millionaire Tiger Hung is told to find cure at the mysterious all-women martial arts sect Omei, and there he meets Omei's young master May. The healing process moves smoothly until May's big sister Misery shows up and challenges May into a duel. Misery has lost her mind and she threatens to destroy Omei unless May beats her with the sect's long-lost 'Heartbreak Sword Technique'...

programme.title: The Contract
programme.desc: The contract is a piece of almost blank paper by which MTV binds all its employees to eight years of impecunious service. Chi-Man, an aspiring but frustrated artist, hates the contract since he is given no chance of getting ahead. He constantly thinks of moving to greener pastures. His brother Chi-Ying is a self-made investor who has just come up with a laugh bomb. By chance, Chi-Man becomes the host of a Cat TV program. With the aid of the laugh bomb, he becomes an instant success, yet...

programme.title: Wheels On Meals
programme.desc: Thomas and David are two quick-witted vendors hawking Chinese fast food from their truck in the busy squares of Barcelona. Their acquaintance with beautiful pickpocket, Sylvia, brings them in contact with novice detective Moby, who is trying to track her whereabouts. Sylvia is actually a wealthy heiress kidnapped by the evil count, who is trying to siphon off her inheritance. The trio puts a spanner in the count's plans, and rescue Sylvia...

programme.title: Black Mask II
programme.desc: Black Mask is back as he tries to find a cure for the genetic mutation that gives him superhuman powers. However, he finds trouble with a demented scientist, Moloch, who uses a group of pro wrestlers in his experiment to combine animal DNA with human DNA. Things get worse when Black Mask's arch nemesis, Lang, has plans of his own involving Moloch and his mutants...

programme.title: She Shoots Straight
programme.desc: One by one, the Huangs died in the course of safeguarding law and order in Hong Kong. First, the father and then the two elder sons gave their lives in action. That leaves Tsung-pao, the youngest son, and four daughters. They are all police officers. What makes the mother prouder is Tsung-pao's marrying a senior policewoman Mina. Old Mrs. Huang is hoping to see a grandson to carry on the lawmen family tree. But the sisters don't like Mina. They make sure she does not have a good time. Mina suffers in silence. A raid on a Vietnamese gang was ordered. Tsung-pao and Mina to command. But sister Ling commits a serious mistake and the whole operation fails. Ling is suspended. She blames it on Mina...

programme.title: 1995 Collections: A Chinese Odyssey (Part I - Pandora's Box)
programme.desc: At the foothills of Fingers Mountain, there is one Highwaymen's Haven, operating as a motel. The gang leader is a fellow named The Joker, and the gang makes a living out of robbing the traveling businessmen and scholars. The Joker is in fact Monkey King reincarnated. Grandpa Buddha is the only God who knows about this. Two of the devils, Spider Woman and Boney M, took the guise of Sharon Stone and Madonna and wooed him into betraying this secret. The two devils decided to get the Joker out of the way so that they could capture the Longevity Monk when the time came for his reincarnation...

programme.title: The Other Side Of Gentleman
programme.desc: A group of intellectuals, who all actively involved in a psychological research, assume a subject Fai, who is innocent and aimless in his life, to test if love can make him into a different person. Jo Jo is the chosen girl to carry out the mission, who attracts Fai with her elegance and beauty. At the same time, she finds herself attracted by him. She wants Professor Cheung, her boyfriend, to stop such a cruel test, but she fails. The final commitment comes when Jo Jo marries to Cheung. Fai interrupts the wedding ceremony in the church by announcing his love to Jo Jo...

programme.title: Shanghai Grand
programme.desc: The Taiwan military officer, Hsu falls into the enemy's ambush, and floats to the Shanghai shore where he is saved by Ting Lik. Lik teams up with Kueng to try to make a fortune and soon they become famous in Shanghai. The Shanghai tycoon Fung try to eliminate other opponents with the help of Hsu and Lik. Later, Hsu discovers Fung is the mastermind of the ambush that killed all his fellow officials...

programme.title: Tiger and Crane E15
programme.desc: 《虎鶴妖師錄》講述了樂觀開朗的山野孤兒虎子因誤打誤撞吞食了至陽寶物赤珠，而結識了冷峻潔癖的國御妖師隊長祁曉軒。兩個性格迥異的年輕人因一顆赤珠被迫一起上路，結識了趙馨彤、王羽千、 山茶等夥伴，就在人妖兩界的野心要為人間帶來一場浩劫之時，一眾有夢想的熱血少年不惜自我犧牲，拯救人間的故事。

programme.title: The Truth Within E16
programme.desc: 法醫齊思哲在調查女友死因的過程中，捲入一樁樁懸案，與刑警祝青越、韓烽攜手屢破詭案，並牽扯出背後「原鑽」毒品疑案的故事。

programme.title: Nothing but You E13
programme.desc: 人生進入瓶頸期的職場精英梁友安和習慣了坐冷板凳的運動員宋三川，因緣際會加入了一個草臺網球俱樂部。他們一個是半路出家的俱樂部經理人，一個是羽毛球轉網球的運動員，兩人和隊友們克服困難共同奮戰，努力打造一個了不起的職業俱樂部。在此過程中，梁友安和宋三川逐漸萌生愛意，也面臨著來自觀念和閱歷的衝突。俱樂部不斷髮展，他們在一次次應對挑戰中超越自我、加強信任，最終收穫職業成長和美好愛情。

programme.title: Twenty Your Life On 2 E3
programme.desc: 講述了大學畢業三年後，羅豔（李庚希飾）經媽媽介紹進入一家離家不遠的傳統型公司做閒差，別人羨慕她輕鬆悠閒，她卻厭倦了枯燥的生活；出入高檔寫字樓的姜小果（卜冠今飾）實際上每天加班沒有自己的生活；突如其來的家庭經濟危機讓段家寶（董思怡飾）從「富二代」變成了「負二代」；梁爽（關曉彤飾）成了全網頂尖的美妝護膚主播，但她的事業起起伏伏。儘管生活的路總是令人困惑而踟躕，但女孩們從不停止向前的腳步。這是充滿艱難，也充滿光明的25歲。

HKSAPD Presents: Together To The Top E1
The Force of Nature 2022 S1E1 -The Force of Nature
programme.desc: Climate change is our defining crisis, and it is happening even faster than we thought. But we're not powerless to stop it. The impacts of climate change are felt in every corner of the world. Increased temperatures are causing environmental disasters. The sea levels are rising, the Arctic is melting, coral reefs are dying, oceans are acidifying, and forests are burning. It is clear that business as usual is not an option. With climate change reaching irreversible heights, now is the time for bold collective action. The climate emergency is a race we are losing, but it is a race we can win.

programme.title: Man Eats Wild S1E3 -Up with the Gods / Himalayan Tahr
programme.desc: After being dropped off into the mountains where there were only whispers and tales of mountain monsters being seen. Mario is on the search of the outer limits of the mountains to find himself a monster red deer. His arrow successfully finds a big red and he showcases some recipes he learnt from the southern regions of Italy form leading celebrity chefs. But not before a mammoth carry out through the back country of the Deep South.

programme.title: Man Eats Wild S1E4 -Outback Odyssey / Arabian Camel
programme.desc: Mario teams up with good friend and precision rifle expert Bernard and heads into the high alpine mountains above New Zealnd’s rugged West Coast in search of tahr. Drawing on his Greek roots, Mario cooks a rustic “Kleftiko” dish in an earth oven.

programme.title: Brave Wilderness S2E13 -Dangerous Jobs (Snakes & Caimans)
programme.desc: Coyote experiences the world's deadliest job with Australian snakes and catches a caiman.

programme.title: Brave Wilderness S2E14 -Milking the Deadly Black Mamba & Green Mamba!
programme.desc: Coyote Peterson milks the deadly green and black mambas for life-saving research!

programme.title: Diamond River Hunters S1E6 -Cut and Dried
programme.desc: The pressure is on to find the big stones before the winter snow drives the team from the valley. A geological survey reveals there is a huge opportunity.

programme.title: Making Pandas S1E1
programme.desc: The iconic Giant Panda is on the brink. With only 1600 left in the wild, pressures on their natural habitat and a notoriously small window for reproduction are edging them towards extinction - fast. Over 1 year, we go behind-the-scenes and follow the incredible work of a dedicated group of zookeepers and vets as they race to get Singapore’s famed couple… to fall in ‘love’. The team from the River Safari has a tough road ahead. This film follows the year that Kai Kai and Jia Jia become the focus of attention not just from the general public but from the scientists themselves in the greatest challenge Singapore Zoo has faced yet.

programme.title: Fishing The Wild S1E9 -Iceland Atlantic Salmon Part 2
programme.desc: Mike vists Iceland to catch Atlantic salmon and meet a wild food chef. Part 2.

programme.title: Fishing The Wild S1E10 -Bibery Trout Farm
programme.desc: Mike tries to catch the predators in his new lake to stock it with trout.

programme.title: Billy Goes North S1E3 -Snakes on a Boat
programme.desc: Billy and his partner Derick remove a nest of snakes from a houseboat, then he responds to a storage facility where some deer-elk hybrids are threatening to injure clients.

programme.title: Billy Goes North S1E4 -Paranormal Extermination
programme.desc: Billy responds to a construction site where a vicious varmint has the tradespeople running scared. Then Billy and Bea investigate a haunted house to find the source of some strange noises.

programme.title: Save this Rhino S1E1
programme.desc: Kevin Pietersen (KP) invites Matt Wright to South Africa, to visit the Kruger National Park area, and show him the state of play and understand the world of poaching. Aside from his success in cricket, KP has also been a fierce and passionate member of the global choir singing to save the rhino. It’s Matt’s first time in South Africa, but it’s not the first time he’s had to face the problem of endangered species. They will meet baby Arthur, who lost his mum to poaching alongside many other baby rhinos who suffered the same fate. Angered and emotional at this dire situation, KP and Matt seek answers to why people would do this. It’s an emotional experience, and it cements the need to find solutions fast, and there may be one already. What becomes blatantly obvious is that the problem is challenging and solutions convoluted.

programme.title: Save this Rhino S1E2
programme.desc: Although the situation is bleak, there is hope. Back at an undisclosed reserve, Matt, KP and Graeme Smith meet another kind of team saving rhinos. From perimeter and ground-based technologies to revolutionary communication and data analysing systems, they are diving into what could be the future of wildlife conservation. Technology seems an obvious solution, but it can’t be the sole strategy, so the team visit a local community who have started a wildlife tourism reserve, which blends employment with the survival of species. It really is a war that is intensifying, and the guys witness the high level of security to protect rhinos against impending incursions at a private game reserve where another baby rhino is roaming freely with his mum. Unfortunately, it’s the exception rather than the rule. Most rhinos struggle to survive. If they survive at all. The clock is ticking, and if these solutions don’t work, they might all be gone by 2025.

programme.title: The Force of Nature 2022 S1E1 -The Force of Nature
programme.desc: Climate change is our defining crisis, and it is happening even faster than we thought. But we're not powerless to stop it. The impacts of climate change are felt in every corner of the world. Increased temperatures are causing environmental disasters. The sea levels are rising, the Arctic is melting, coral reefs are dying, oceans are acidifying, and forests are burning. It is clear that business as usual is not an option. With climate change reaching irreversible heights, now is the time for bold collective action. The climate emergency is a race we are losing, but it is a race we can win.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT S6E7 -Dogfight
programme.desc: Mikey shows a veteran Buffalo’s DC-3, WZS, Buffalo’s very own vintage plane from the Second World War. It is being fitted with a special ‘static’ line, which paratroopers will clip onto for a D- Day reenactment jump. But army inspectors tell Mikey a modern military needs a modern line with a winch system in case they need to retrieve a “hung-up jumper”. Cory and Mikey scramble to build the retrieval line before the inspector comes back to test it. But with their bumbling and fumbling, it doesn’t look like they will make the cut. Meanwhile, Chris Staples and some of Buffalo’s pilots head down to Fullerton, California, to Air Combat USA, where pilots get to experience aerial dogfights in real fighter planes. The pilots do yo-yos, spins and pull Gs to out-maneuver their opponent. First up in the dogfights are newly checked-out co-pilot Sam Storm versus longtime co-pilot David Alexandre. Sam wins the fight due to David’s inability to hold down his breakfast. Next up is cocky co-pilot Chris

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT S6E8 -D-Day
programme.desc: The Buffalo boys gather in Red Deer for Mikey’s D-Day tribute jump. Joe and Sam scout out the designated military drop zone over Abraham Lake in the Rockies only to discover the canyon is too narrow for the DC-3. So Joe cancels the whole thing—it’s too dangerous. Mikey uses Joe’s own philosophy against him: at Buffalo, there’s always a backup plan. Joe flies out to scout a new location for the drop on the lake but hits bad weather. As Joe is about to scrap the trip, twenty paratroopers from the Canadian and American armies arrive for the big jump and are ready to go. They board WZS and Joe takes off to a site he hasn’t scouted, in weather that just keeps getting worse. As they near the drop point, he finally calls it—no jump tonight. They turn back, with all the troops still on board. Mikey’s only hope is a narrow window first thing the next morning—but only if Joe gives the final okay.
